source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cis-trans isomerism (PDF 31-32).

blocks.text: Cis-trans isomers mein aik jaise ligands ya to saath saath (90 darje par, cis) ya aamne saamne (180 darje par, trans) hote hain. Yeh square planar complexes, maslan [Pt(NH3)2Cl2], aur octahedral complexes, maslan [Co(NH3)4Cl2]+, mein aam hai.

cis-[Pt(NH3)2Cl2] (cisplatin) mein chlorine atoms saath saath, 90 darje par, aur trans-[Pt(NH3)2Cl2] (transplatin) mein aamne saamne, 180 darje par hain. Dono isomers ki khasiyatein mukhtalif hain: cisplatin cancer ki dawa hai, transplatin nahi. Transplatin mein aik jaise ligands ke bond dipoles ulti simton mein ho kar khatam ho jate hain, is liye molecule non-polar hai; cisplatin mein khatam nahi hote, dipole moment banta hai, is liye polar hai.

blocks.alt: Dashed square par bane do square-planar Pt complexes. cis-platin: dono Cl baen konon par aur dono NH3 daen konon par, yani Cl saath saath. trans-platin: Cl peechhe baen aur aage daen, NH3 peechhe daen aur H3N aage baen, yani Cl aamne saamne.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.11: Geometrical isomers, cisplatin aur transplatin (kitab ki Figure 18.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein beech ka Pt atom chhapne se reh gaya hai; khaake mein beech mein Pt likha hai. Cisplatin mein dono Cl 90 darje par hain, is liye bond dipoles khatam nahi hote aur molecule polar hai; transplatin mein Cl 180 darje par hain, dipoles khatam ho jate hain aur molecule non-polar hai. Wedge wale bonds aage aur saade bonds peechhe hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat: cisplatin
blocks.text: Cisplatin, cis-diamminedichloroplatinum(II), cancer ki aik sang-e-meel dawa hai. Yeh ittefaqan daryaft hui, jab maloom hua ke platinum electrodes bacteria ke cells ki taqseem rok dete hain. Tezi se taqseem hone wale cancer cell ke andar paani is ke chloride ligands ki jagah le leta hai; phir yeh fa'aal dawa DNA ke guanine bases se jur kar dhaagon ko aapas mein jor deti hai, jo DNA ki naqal rokta aur cell ki muqarrara maut (apoptosis) shuru karta hai.
[Co(NH3)4(H2O)2]3+ aik [MA4B2] octahedral complex hai. Is ke cis isomer mein do H2O ligands saath saath, 90 darje par, aur trans isomer mein aamne saamne, 180 darje par hain.

blocks.alt: OCTAHEDRAL COMPLEX ION ke unwan ke neeche [Co(NH3)4(H2O)2]3+ ke do khaake, har aik mein Co se guzarta peela square plane aur aik ligand oopar aur aik neeche. cis-isomer: aik H2O plane ke oopar aur doosra plane ke kone par, 90 darje par. trans-isomer: dono H2O plane ke aamne saamne konon par, 180 darje par; NH3 oopar aur neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.12: [Co(NH3)4(H2O)2]3+ ke geometrical isomers (kitab ki Figure 18.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka, us ke do isomers ki shakal mein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.12 chaar khaake (i) se (iv) chhaapti hai, jaise chaar isomers hon. Un mein (i), (ii) aur (iv) aik hi cis isomer hain (dono H2O 90 darje par, bas mukhtalif rukh se bane), aur (iii) trans isomer hai (H2O 180 darje par). [MA4B2] octahedral complex ke sirf do geometrical isomers hote hain, cis aur trans, is liye khaake mein yahi do bane hain: cis (kitab ka i) aur trans (kitab ka iii).

blocks.prompt: [Pt(NH3)2Cl2] ka kaun sa isomer polar hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Cis isomer: is ke do Pt-Cl bond dipoles 90 darje par hain aur khatam nahi hote, is liye molecule ka dipole moment hai.

items: cis: aik jaise ligands 90 darje par; trans: 180 darje par.
Cisplatin polar aur cancer ki dawa; transplatin non-polar.
[Co(NH3)4(H2O)2]3+ jaise octahedral [MA4B2] complexes bhi cis-trans isomerism dikhate.
